verdict.rationale: Terraform documents passing input variables at runtime via -var and -var-file, which keeps values out of configuration code. It also recommends remote backends or HCP Terraform to store state securely. A community report confirms that 'sensitive variables' exist in Terraform Cloud/Enterprise, but notes that secrets are stored unencrypted in state, so secrets can still be exposed at rest. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of sensitive-value redaction in plan/apply output and logs, documented secret-manager integration, state encryption, and hands-on corroboration that secrets stay out of logs.
